scope: V2.1 Phase 1 clean/order4 and cable/order5 real Preview visual sample review at 390x844
acceptanceBoundary: Root and agent judged these technical visual samples suitable for propagation. This is not the user's final aesthetic approval, all-orders regression, physical touch validation or platform certification.

rootReview.source: Root agent's explicit review message in the current task; root performed the real Preview operations
rootReview.clean: 新57%局部擦除方向清晰，旧横贯大部分设备宽的硬水平透明边界已消除；键盘比0%旧V2更易读，残尘错落，96%保持少量而非提前清空。
rootReview.cable: 接头金属形状及凹槽明显可辨，蓝曲线圆润；后续多线下需再实测标签遮挡，中央非交互标题跨线的小不足保留。
rootReview.decision: 主观技术视觉样板通过，满足推广条件；不代表用户最终审美批准。

agentReview.method: Read-only direct inspection of the 17 original screenshots listed below, followed by lossless native-size composition. No shared Creator/browser operation and no runtime-source edits.
clean: 0%键帽和键盘主体可辨认，初始灰尘比旧V2更轻、更分散；木工作台、防静电垫和唯一清洁进度保留。
新57%样板呈左上、下中等局部错落残尘；对照旧V2相同57%中跨越大部分键盘宽度的水平透明边界，该生硬条带在当前样板中已不再可见。
local-backforth截图仍显示57%，灰尘图案与前一57%截图基本一致，支持根任务记录的已清区域回扫不增加逻辑计数；截图本身不独立证明所有ownership及CANCEL路径。
96%时大部分键帽已干净，左上与空格键附近仍有少量残尘；该数值是27/28要求格进度，不是可见灰尘质量或像素清除比例，也不意味着32/32格被清除。
cable: 0/3三个插头与右侧不同槽形明显比旧图标式V2更易区分，方向、金属头和凹槽更清楚。
1/3截图只见蓝色显示线固定成功，另外两个线头仍在左侧，未出现伪全连。
错误释放后的截图仍为1/3，失误由0变1，红色电源头回到左侧；这些是画面及root操作记录，不能单凭静态图证明完整动画时长。
蓝色弧线较圆润，关键端口文字仍可读；弧线贴近/穿过中央非交互装饰标题牌，保留为轻微布局不足。
agentReview.decision: 当前清洁/接线样板未见阻塞推广的明显视觉回归；适合继续对应订单验证，最终美术仍需用户审查。

lastSnapEvidence.behaviorExplanation: The existing final 0.15-second successful snap records completion and invokes settlement in the same business frame. No artificial completion delay was introduced to obtain a promotional screenshot.

comparisonCaveats: Clean comparison uses the same order4, 390x844 viewport and rendered57% (16/28 required cells); the old capture followed a row-oriented path while the new capture followed diagonal/arc paths, so it is not a controlled identical-input comparison.

Cable comparison uses the same order5, 390x844 viewport and rendered1/3; V2 connected red power while V2.1 connected blue display. It supports comparison of plug/socket legibility and line treatment, not an identical-cable geometry claim.
Natural timers, errors and intermediate states can differ between old and new captures. No game image was reconstructed or retouched.

remainingIssues.observation: This review covers phone order4/order5 samples; later multi-item/multi-cable orders, other viewports, full-run controls and user final aesthetic review are separate.

outputs.pixelPolicy: Full native390x844 source rectangles copied into PNG. Labels/borders remain outside game pixels; no crop, resizing, recoloring, repainting or added success indicators.
outputs.verification: The generator compares every embedded RGB pixel against its decoded original both in memory and after reopening each PNG. It hashes all existing V2/V2.1 screenshot files before and after composition.
